more_info.overview: Yellow 2G is a synthetic azo dye specified as the disodium salt of a chlorinated, sulphonated pyrazole-containing colour molecule. Its colouring function is to add or restore colour in the food. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation.
